requirements: Access the Hueycoatl encounter and prepare an appropriate melee setup and supplies.

steps.text: Wait at marker 8 as the tail phase starts. Watch the wave yourself before using the following movement cues.
When the wave reaches blue marker 2, click marker 3.
Click the tail when the wave reaches marker 1.
Markers 4 and 5 are the source pack's right-wave safespot references.
Markers 6 and 7 are the source pack's left-wave safespot references.
When the tip of the tail reaches marker 9, click to dodge the left wave. The marker is a timing reference; observe the tail in game.
When the tip of the tail reaches marker 10, click the tail to dodge the right wave.
At marker 11, zoom out and click the boss to return to the encounter.

entries.title: Inferno · 69 wave guides
entries.subtitle: Numbered openings · pillar decisions · Jad and Zuk phases
requirements: Sacrifice a fire cape to unlock entry.
Bring the combat equipment, Ancient Magicks and supplies required by your chosen setup.

steps.text: Wave 1: 3 × Jal-Nib (nibbler); 1 × Jal-MejRah (bat).
Open at 1 (xZact). Cast on the nibblers, then assess which enemies can reach you before leaving pillar cover.
Remove exposed bats promptly. Reference 2 is the north-pillar bat position; its protection depends on the bat being on the other side of the pillar.
When the wave is controlled, recover supplies and choose the next wave. Marker 3 is an alternative opening reference, not a timed instruction.
Wave 2: 3 × Jal-Nib (nibbler); 2 × Jal-MejRah (bat).
Open at 1 (xZact). Cast on the nibblers, then assess which enemies can reach you before leaving pillar cover.
Remove exposed bats promptly. Reference 2 is the north-pillar bat position; its protection depends on the bat being on the other side of the pillar.
When the wave is controlled, recover supplies and choose the next wave. Marker 3 is an alternative opening reference, not a timed instruction.
Wave 3: 6 × Jal-Nib (nibbler).
Open at 1 (xZact). Cast on the nibblers, then assess which enemies can reach you before leaving pillar cover.
Clear all six nibblers. With no combat enemies left, recover and return to the next opening before the final kill.
Wave 4: 3 × Jal-Nib (nibbler); 1 × Jal-Ak (blob).
Open at 1 (xZact). Cast on the nibblers, then assess which enemies can reach you before leaving pillar cover.
Handle the blob's prayer scan and delayed opposite-style hit; after a kill, account for the three bloblets before leaving cover.
When the wave is controlled, recover supplies and choose the next wave. Marker 3 is an alternative opening reference, not a timed instruction.

entries.title: Abyssal Sire
entries.subtitle: Separate the respiratory opening from the close-range final phases.
requirements: An abyssal demon or Abyssal Sire assignment

steps.text: Position: Outside the Sire's melee reach, with a clear route between the four systems.
Movement cue: After a Shadow spell stuns the Sire, move to the next respiratory system.
Stun the Sire.
Destroy the four systems during the stun windows.
Avoid: Attacking the Sire before the systems are destroyed.
Position: Beside the Sire, with space to leave poison pools.
Movement cue: Step away as a poison pool appears under your position.
Attack in melee range.
Move onto clean ground and resume attacking.
Position: On clean ground close enough to resume melee after the blast.
Movement cue: Immediately leave the Sire after its final-phase teleport.
Run clear of the explosion.
Return and finish the Sire while avoiding poison and spawns.

entries.title: Agrith Naar
entries.subtitle: Use Silverlight for the finishing blow.
requirements: Reach the finale of Shadow of the Storm

steps.text: Position: Inside the ritual area with Silverlight available.
Movement cue: Engage after the summoning dialogue resolves.
Use your prepared combat setup.
Keep Silverlight ready for the final hit.
Position: In melee range with Silverlight equipped.
Movement cue: Switch to Silverlight before the finishing blow.
Complete the kill with Silverlight.
Finish the quest dialogue.

entries.title: Ahrim the Blighted
entries.subtitle: A separate Barrows brother lesson for crypt and tunnel encounters.

steps.text: Position: Beside the sarcophagus with the stairs accessible.
Movement cue: Activate Protect from Magic before opening the sarcophagus.
Open the sarcophagus and defeat the brother.
Watch Magic stat drains and keep your attack setup equipped.
Position: On clear tunnel floor with the brother visible.
Movement cue: Reapply the chosen protection before fighting the brother in the tunnels.
Finish the brother before looting the chest.
Avoid letting tunnel creatures distract you from the brother.

entries.title: Akkha
entries.subtitle: Watch style changes and memorise the quadrant sequence before moving.
requirements: Reach Akkha in Tombs of Amascut

steps.text: Position: In the quadrant matching the team's chosen position.
Movement cue: Change gear and protection when Akkha changes style.
Attack with the style Akkha is not protecting.
Step away from the marked detonation.
Position: At the start of the displayed quadrant sequence.
Movement cue: Walk the remembered sequence after the display finishes.
Destroy Akkha's shadows before their special completes.
Adjust for your active invocations.
Position: On a clear path between the moving orbs.
Movement cue: Move toward Akkha's new position without crossing an orb.
Use controlled clicks.
Finish the final phase before attempting butterfly optimisation.

entries.title: Alchemical Hydra
entries.subtitle: Walk each coloured form over its matching chemical vent.
requirements: Boots of stone, boots of brimstone or Kourend & Kebos elite diary for the dungeon

steps.text: Position: Near the red chemical vent; let the Hydra follow over the vent.
Movement cue: After the vent weakens the green form, move to the next vent route.
Count its repeating three-attack style blocks.
Step away from poison after it lands.
Position: Position the blue form on the green vent, then lead red onto the blue vent.
Movement cue: Leave the electricity path and fire trail as each special begins.
Maintain the correct vent order: red, green, blue.
Keep a clean route for the fire special.
Position: In attack range on clean ground.
Movement cue: The Hydra changes attack style after every attack in the final form.
Switch protection after each attack.
Avoid the repeated poison special and finish.

entries.title: Amoxliatl
entries.subtitle: Sidestep ice spikes, restore Magic protection and break the summoned ice blocks.

steps.text: Position: In attack range with clear adjacent floor.
Movement cue: Leave a tile when an ice spike grows under it.
Keep Protect from Magic active.
Use short sidesteps and resume attacking.
Position: At a clean tile with the prayer controls ready.
Movement cue: Reactivate Protect from Magic after the prayer-disabling attack.
Watch for the following icicle.
Keep health high while recovering.
Position: Beside the summoned ice blocks.
Movement cue: Switch to the blocks when they appear.
Destroy the blocks with melee before they explode and heal the boss.
Return to Amoxliatl afterwards.

entries.title: Araxxor
entries.subtitle: Control the egg spawns before learning the enrage movement.

steps.text: Position: Beside the boss, leaving clean space away from acid.
Movement cue: React to the colour of the newly hatched araxyte.
Avoid damaging a mirrorback while it reflects.
